{{Top}}
[[File:JarJarTongue-BlastOff.png|thumb|250px|[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] displays his long tongue.]]
{{Quote|I want their tongues!|[[Pirate/Legends|Pirate]] leader [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]|<ref name="Revival">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>}}
A '''tongue''' was a fleshy strip of muscle located in the mouths of many [[Species/Legends|species]] and creatures across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] species had long muscular tongues which they used to scoop [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusks]] and small edible [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] from the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of their home planet, [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWE Gungans">{{SWE|groups|gungans|Gungans}}</ref> [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] had a bad habit of using his tongue to grab fruit from tables. [[Opee sea killer/Legends|Opee sea killers]] used their long tongues to capture [[Scalefish/Legends|scalefish]] in the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and seas of Naboo.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Spiced aric tongue]] was considered a delicacy.<ref name="CPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> [[Shimmerbird/Legends|Shimmerbirds]]' tongues were the source for [[Shimmerbird tongue robe/Legends|robes]] that were worn by member of the [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] species. Members of the odd [[Temptor/Legends|Temptor]] species had very long flexible tongues used to attract prey.<ref name="AOTCVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
